scope: The exact artifacts a Phase 0 measurement run must use to qualify the current model candidate. Binding a run to anything else produces diagnostics, never release evidence.

rejectedContextModelSha256.b6dde70259d75790d8685884a50b9939f88befd5: macOS independent-split export. Its context training saw 47,931 CTC test paths and 2,226 validation paths, so joint tap/swipe evaluation against it is not valid. This is the artifact the 2026-09-11 GrapheneOS run actually measured.
rejectedContextModelSha256.53e1a1d29566efaa4ca3fe1b396206c10d211cdb: Canonical Linux export of the same independent-split weights. Reproducible, but carries the identical split defect.
rejectedContextModelSha256.9f09d7b37ff4c7f1bc0a7c7e5918ea860eb26e1a: Experimental small shared-session student. Not the release candidate.

notes: appCommit, coreApkSha256 and testApkSha256 are per-build and cannot be pinned in source. The driver verifies the APK actually installed on the device against the value bound into metadata instead.

The pinned context model cannot be produced from this checkout, and not merely because the ONNX bytes are absent. Every retained artifact belongs to the rejected independent-split run: the only full context weights present are 95384df3d674f2022c84f0b56528e735db9505295732f6421d90618adefaff14, no training report matching the shared-session run df174d415bbedbbc5424d66f8f598bad84621cb1a114df081d5671fcb1a09860 exists, and the retained teacher-scored corpus counts 61,620/3,364/3,764 train/validation/test, which is the independent split; the shared-session corpus is 61,604/3,253/3,637. Reaching this hash therefore requires regenerating the shared-session split, re-scoring it with the retained teacher, re-running the four-epoch distillation and only then the Linux export.

The Linux export image that produced this hash is retained as libreboard-context-export:local (sha256:762a8eb3ed9a4252df95cbd4bca31fd58e80e76d0f50c73567896157c0092300), so the export step is reproducible once the weights exist again.
docs/models/joint-session-splits.md records the split exposure that disqualifies the rejected artifacts.
